translation.name: An it jilchith cau cʼal i Ajatic Jesucristo

book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: An c’a’al u axi thuchanchat an ebchalabchic ti Corinto c’al an t’ocat abathuale Pablo

content: Ejtha a Cristo
Ebchalabchic, ca t’ila’ an alhua’ cau axi nan tu olchamal. Ja’its ax a bats’umalchic ani a junini’ aynanchal.
Ja’its c’al tit jec’onthabchic max ca lej junini’ aynanchiye, i canats quit jolatmethanchat a belomtal.

Pel i cau lej c’athpich in ey jahua’ tim pitha’ a Dios ani nan tu huat’banchichic tata’chic. Tu exobchamalchic abal tsemets a Cristo ti calchix c’al huahua’ i hualab jant’ini’ tin ulal ti al an T’ocat Thuchlab.
Joliyat ani ti ox a q’uicha ejtha jant’ini’ tin ulal an T’ocat Thuchlab.
Tam ti ejthachits, tam ti tejhua’mejits c’al a Pedro ani talbel jaye c’al axi lajuj tsab i abathualechic tamcuthits.
Ani talbel tejhua’me c’al bo’ i bo’ inic i ebchalabchic tamcuthits jaye. Tsemetsits talchic jaja’chic nixe’ ani hua’atschic axi ejate.
Talbel tejhua’me jaye c’al a Jacobo ani c’al tim patal in abathualejilchic a Dios.
Antsana’ ti tejhua’menec a Cristo c’al patal nixe’chic ax tu uchalchic, ani lej talbelits tam ti tejhua’me jaye c’al nana’ cum lej talbelits tam tu bela’.
Tim patal an abathualechic nan yab jant’o tin exbath, ma yab in tomnalac quim punuhuat tin abathuale cum ti jayq’ui’ u lej othnanchamal im bichohuil a Dios.

A Dios tim punu tin abathuale expith tin ebal in alhua’ inictal. Ani yab jolat tim punu, cum u lej c’athpich t’ojonchamal in t’ojlabil yab ejtil xi q’ue’at an abathualechic. Jahua’ u bajumal cu t’aja’ yab tu cuetemtal, expith cum a Dios tin lej tsaplilinchal u ichich c’al in alhua’ inictal.
Yab lej exbath jita’ c’al tit olchame an alhua’ cau max c’al nana’ o max c’al q’ue’at i abathualechic. Jahua’ lej exbath jats it olchamejits an alhua’ cau ani jats a belchamalchic.
Ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic
I olnamalits abal ejthachits a Cristo, ani jale’ hualam hua’ats jita’chic c’al tata’ ax in ulal abal yab ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic.
Max yab ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic, tam yab ejthachits a Cristo jaye.
Ani max yab ejthachits a Cristo, tam jolatits an alhua’ cau ax i olnal ani jolatits jaye abal a belamalchic.

Max yab ejthachits a Cristo, tam pel u janamcau huahua’ abal i olnamalits abal a Dios in ejthamalits. Max yab chubax ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic c’al a Dios, tam yab chubax ejthamejits a Cristo c’al a Dios.
Yab chubax ejthachits a Cristo max yab ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic.
Ani max yab chubax ejthachits a Cristo, jolat abal a belchamal an alhua’ cau ani yab it paculanchithits a hualab.
Max yab chubax ejthachits a Cristo, tam t’ajat q’uibenequits ax im belamal a Cristo ani xohue’ tsemenec.
Lej ts’ejhuantal huahua’ tu c’ambihuale max expith teje’ tsabal tu lablinchal a Cristo ani yab talbelaquits tam cu tsemets cu lablinchat jaye ti eb.
Lej chubax a Dios in ejtha’ a Cristo ti al an jolimtalab, ani ja’its jaja’ axi c’a’al ejthame c’al patal an tsemelomchic axi taye talbel ne’ets ca ejtha.
Tin ebal juncats i inic jats ti ts’i’quin an tsemla, ani jaye tin ebal juncats i inic jats ti ne’ets ca ejtha an inicchic.
Cum patal an inicchic pel in juntal a Adán jats tu tsemel. Ani patal axi pel in c’al a Cristo ne’ets ca ejtha.
Ne’ets ca ejtha jant’inits ti bijchith ca ejthachic. Oc’ox ejtha a Cristo, ani talbelaquits ca huichiy jaja’ ne’ets ca ejthanchat jaye axi pel in c’al jaja’.

Ne’ets ca taley an q’uij q’uicha tam a Cristo quin talabethanchi in ey patal axi abatnomchic ani axi oc’lecchic ani ax u eyalchic teje’ tsabal. Tiq’uele ne’ets quim binanchi patal an abatnaxtalab tin c’ubac in Tata Dios abal jaja’ ca jilc’on ti lej Ts’ale.
Biyat xohue’ a Dios im bijiyamalits a Cristo quin t’aja’ ti lej Ts’ale teje’ tsabal. Ca jilc’on ti lej Ts’ale ma tam ta ca tala’ atanthanchatits c’al a Dios tim patal axi tomolnax c’al a Cristo.
An taltalab tomolnax axi ne’ets ca talabetha jats an tsemla.

In ulal an T’ocat Thuchlab abal a Dios im punumalits a Cristo ti lej Abatnom c’al patal jant’o hua’ats ani jita’ hua’ats. Abal in ulal patal, yab in le’ quin ulu max ne’ets ca abatna a Dios c’al a Cristo, cum jats a Dios ax im punumalits a Cristo ti Abatnom.

Tam ti a Cristo quim bajuhuits quin tala’ abatna’ patal jant’o hua’ats ani jita’ hua’ats, tamna’ jaja’ tin lej Tsacamil a Dios ne’ets quim bina’ tim ba’ ca abatna c’al in Tata c’al ti punuhuat ti Abatnom. Antsana’ a Dios ne’ets ca jilc’on ti lej c’athpich pulic Abatnom c’al patal.
Ca t’aja’chic ti cuenta jaye abal hua’ats jita’chic ax u pujnal tin cuenta axi tsemenecchic. Jolat ca pujan antsana’ max yab ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic.
Max yab ne’ets cu ejtha, jolat qui cuxuy i yajchictalab ax i ets’ey yajchicnal teje’ tsabal.
Patal a q’uicha c’unatits an tsemla tin cua’al cum hua’ats jita’chic ax in le’ tiquin tsemtha’. Aba ani’ antsana’its ebchalabchic, bel in lej culbel cum a belalchic i Ajatic Jesucristo.

Tam tin c’uajatac ti Efeso tin olnom c’al an alhua’ cau tin yajchiquiy i pathay inicchic in ey ejtil max pel i tse’ acan lej thimalon. Jolat u yajchicnamal antsana’ max yab quin ejtha talbel tam in tsemenecaquits. Max chubax yab u ejthab an tsemelomchic, tam jun t’ajat qui t’ajchiquiyq’ui jant’ini’ u uluhuab c’al talchic i inic, cu c’apuplatsq’ui ani cu uts’uts’latsq’ui cum hualam cu tsemetsq’ui calam ani ja’its expithcua’.
Yab ca hualca’ ta ba’chic quit c’ambinchat a tsalap. Ca t’ila’ jahua’ u uluhuab abal max ca ts’at’ey i alhua’ inic c’al i pojcax inic ne’ets ca ts’ilc’oyat c’al im pojcaxtalcua’.

Ca junini’ co’oy a tsalap ts’ejcacathits ani yab quit hualbinchic. Hua’ats jita’chic c’al tata’ axi yab in tequeth exlanchal in ey a Dios, ani jatschic ca tithebethanchat in ichich c’al axe’ xi thuchath u.
Jant’ini’ hualam in inictal axi ejthachits
Hualam max hua’ats jita’ ne’ets quin conoy jant’ini’ ti ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic ani jant’othats in inquith inictal ne’ets quin co’oy.
Yab lej tsalpath jitats quin conoy antsana’. Ca t’aja’ ti cuenta i iyalab axi ca t’ayan in yejenchal ca joliyat ejtil max tsemenequits ani talbel ca cale tin acan.
Ca t’ayan jahuaquits tam iyalab ani in acan ax u calel yab ejtil an iyalab axi t’aynenec. Max ca t’ayan i iyalab lab em, ca calejits ani in inquith in acan pil tu tejhua’mel.
A Dios im pithal in acan nixe’ xi iyalab jant’ini’ jaja’ quin le’na’. Max pil an iyalab pil jaye in acan.
Jahua’ in cua’al in inictal teje’ tsabal yab jununul in cua’al in inquith. Junits in inictal an inic ani junits in inictal an co’nel. Junits in inictal an ts’itsin ani junits in inictal an to’ol.
Hua’ats ax in cua’al in inictal abal ca c’uajiy tsabal ani hua’ats ax in cua’al in inictal abal ca c’uajiy ti eb. Junits in alabental axi ti eb ani junits in alabental axi ti tsabal.
Junits in maq’uiq’uiltal a q’uicha ani junits in maq’uiq’uiltal a its’. Junits jaye in maq’uiq’uiltal a otchic ani pil ti junchic in tsap in maq’uiq’uiltal.

Antsana’ jaye junits i inictal tam cu tsemets ani junits i inictal qui co’oy tam cu ejtha. Ca joliyat i inictal tam cu tsemets ani u c’atsel, ani ne’ets cu ejtha c’al i it inictal talbel axi ni jayq’ui’ yab ne’ets ca tsemets.
Ca joliyat i ts’ejhuantal inictal, ani cu ejtha c’al i ts’alat inictal. Ca joliyat i bilom inictal ani cu ejtha c’al i inictal axi ne’ets ca lej tsaplilin abal ets’ey.

I inictal axi ca joliyat pel ja i anam t’u’lec. Jats ja c’al tucu xe’tsin teje’ tsabal. I it inictal tam cu ejthajits jats ja c’al tucu lejat xe’tsin ti eb. Max a Dios tu pithal i anam t’u’ul abal cu xe’tsin teje’ tsabal aniye jaye ne’ets tucu pitha’ i inictal in ey abal cu xe’tsin ti eb.
In ulal an T’ocat Thuchlab abal an oc’ox inic Adán ja ts’ejca ani ejatliyat. A Cristo ax u exlab ti taltalab Adán ja’its jaja’ ax tu it ejatliyal abal ets’ey.
Oc’ox tu pithal a Dios i inictal axi teje’ tsabal ani ma talbelaquits ne’ets tucu pitha’ i inictal in ey abal cu c’uajiy ti eb.
An oc’ox inic ja ts’ejca c’al i pojoth ani an Ajatic ax u exlab ti tsabchilab inic ja’its jaja’ axi tal ti eb.

Abal ca c’uajiy teje’ tsabal patal an inicchic in cua’al in inictal ejtil in inictal an oc’ox inic Adán. Axi ne’ets ca c’uajiy ti eb ne’ets ca pithan in inictal ejtil in inictal an Ajatic axi tal ti eb.
Xohue’ i eyits ejtil in ey a Adán axi ts’ejca c’al i pojoth, ani ma talbelaquits ne’ets cu pithan i inictal axi ejtil in inictal an Ajatic axi tal ti eb.

Nan tu uchal ebchalabchic, yab ne’ets qui ejtou cu otsits ti eb jun tin t’ajal a Dios ti lej Ts’ale c’al i inictal axi teje’ tsabal anam t’u’leclith ani xits’lith. Pel in ey i inictal teje’ tsabal u talelom ani axi ne’ets cu pithan ti eb ne’ets ca ohuey abal ets’ey.
Nan u le’ tu tso’oblinchichic jun i tsinat cau. Aba ani’ yab patal huahua’ ne’ets cu tsemets, bel patal huahua’ ne’ets cu jalc’unchat cu pithan i it inictal.

Jun c’uathich i hual ne’ets cu jalc’unchat. Tam ca ats’an in taltal cahuith an trompeta ne’ets ca ejtha an tsemelomchic ani ca pithan in it inictal axi ni jayq’ui’ yab ne’ets ca tsemets. Huahua’ jaye ax u ejate ani i belal a Cristo ne’ets cu jalc’unchat i inictal.

Abal qui ejtou cu c’uajiy ti eb i yejenchal cu jalc’unchat i inictal ax u talelom ani cu pithan in ey ax u ohuel abal ets’ey. Cu jalc’unchat i inictal ax u tsemel ani cu pithan in ey axi ni jayq’ui’ yab u tsemel.

Cu pithanits i inictal ax u ohuel abal ets’ey ani yab u tsemel, yabats ne’ets tucu ata’ an tsemla. Tam ojni’ ne’ets ca putun jahua’ in ulal an T’ocat Thuchlab abal ne’ets ca jum putat paclunchatits in tsap an tsemla.
An tsemla yabats ne’ets quin co’oy in tsap abal tucu c’olchiye i inictal. Yabats ne’ets quin ejtou tucu ataye ni abal jayac.
Cum hua’ats i hualabtalab teje’ tsabal jats c’al tin cua’al in tsap an tsemla tucu c’olo, ani cum hua’ats an ts’ejcath cau jats c’al tin cua’al in tsap an hualabtalab tucu jolbiy.
Qui bina’ i c’ac’namal yan c’al a Dios cum i Ajatic Jesucristo tu atanthanchamalits an hualabtalab ani an tsemla.

Jaxtam c’an ebchalabchic, ca lej junini’ co’oy a ichich c’al an Ajatic mo’cathits ani yab quit jalc’u’inchic. Ets’ey quit puhuehuel t’ojon c’al an Ajatic, cum a tso’obits abal yab jolat max it junax t’ojnal c’al jaja’.
